card.name: Words just before renewal or extension
card.fires_on: Words right before a renewal, extension, replacement or refill is expected, such as 'could be', 'for', 'prior to ref' or 'may be replaced'. Seen with licenses, laws, enlistments and implants.

modes.label: License or law renewal
modes.description: Linking words where a license, law or term is about to be renewed or reauthorized.
modes.example: The law, widely recognized as a remarkable success, was reauthorized in 2006<< in>> a near-unanimous vote in Congress

modes.label: Extension or replacement
modes.description: Words just before a term is extended or an item is replaced or refilled.
modes.example: Enlistment was for six months but could<< be>> extended.

modes.label: Refill wording in labels
modes.description: Partway through the word refilling in a prescribing instruction.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning renew, renewal and extend, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say something will be renewed, extended or replaced.
